messages:
Maria (Customer Success): heads-up — Zephyr dedicated pool go-live tomorrow morning. Need final sign-off on quota, autoscale policy, and load-test window. Sales wants evidence for renewal deck.
Sam (Operations): confirmed reserved pool: 6x A100, 48GB each. Initial commit: 150k tokens/day baseline, expected peak ~1.2M tokens/day. What RPS should we prime for?
Ben (Serving): recommend priming for 220 rps steady with 350 rps peak bursts for the first 6h. KV cache warmup: run 12k unique prefixes.
Anya (SRE): schedule works for me but we need an autoscaler cooldown change — current 180s causes overshoot during burst. Suggest 90s cooldown + target 65% GPU util.
Maria (Customer Success): sales requested a short load-run (30m) with representative prompt set and a 2h soak later. Also want a short clip of 95th/99th latencies for the QBR.
Sam (Operations): OK. Proposed windows: prefix-warm 01:30–02:00 UTC, load-run 02:00–02:30 UTC, soak 04:00–06:00 UTC. Any objections?
Ben (Serving): fine. Load generator snippet I'll use:```bash
# run with k6
k6 run --vus 220 --duration 30m load/zephyr.js --out influxdb=http://influx:8086/zephyr
```
Ben (Serving): payloads will sample the customer prompt corpus, including some long-seq examples to exercise kv-cache.
Anya (SRE): I'll provision temporary SLO dashboards and a canary route. Can you give me the canary token? Also add a fallback policy to route to a smaller model if failures > 2% for 2m.
Maria (Customer Success): granting canary token to Anya now. @Sam please confirm KMS access is in place for Zephyr keys — we need logs for compliance.
Sam (Operations): KMS is scoped already. I'll open the pool and attach KMS alias zephyr-prod-key.
deploy-bot: load-test started at 2026-03-23T02:00:12Z — test id: lt-5509876543-01
Ben (Serving): initial run results: 95th latency 118ms, 99th 310ms, error rate 0.8% (transient 429s during minute 12).
Anya (SRE): saw autoscaler scale events at minute 12 and again at minute 14, cooldown prevented rapid scaling. I think failure spike aligns with container pull throttling on one host. Ops to investigate host-level IO.
Sam (Operations): digging into host logs now. Noted one node had delayed GPU driver restart. I'm evacuating and replacing it.
Ben (Serving): after bumping cooldown to 90s and priming caches we re-ran a short 10m probe: 95th 105ms, 99th 220ms, errors 0.2%. Looks stable.
Maria (Customer Success): perfect — I'm saving these numbers for the renewal pack. Quick action items: 1) Sam to post a short incident note on host IO root cause, 2) Anya to attach canary graphs and chart 95/99 latencies, 3) Ben to upload the 30m load-run artifacts and transcripts.
Sam (Operations): will post incident note in #postmortems with logs by EOD.
Anya (SRE): uploading dashboards to the Zephyr onboarding folder (link shared in DM).
Ben (Serving): artifacts uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-ops/zephyr/lt-5509876543-01.zip
Maria (Customer Success): thanks team — one more: include a brief note about recommended autoscale settings for Zephyr in the customer-facing ops doc. Sales wants a line item for ongoing headroom.
Sam (Operations): recommended: target_util 65%, min_replicas 2, max_replicas 8, cooldown 90s. I'll paste that into the doc. :white_check_mark:
Maria (Customer Success): great — closing sync. I'll update the renewal tracker with a note that the performance evidence is in and the dedicated pool is green for go-live. :rocket:
